## Summary

Adds a "Delete bill" action for bills in `PENDING` status:

- New `deleteBill` resource that calls `DELETE /bill/{uuid}?reason=...`
- New `delete-bill-confirmation-modal` prompting for a required deletion reason
- Delete option surfaced from the bill-history overflow menu (gated on `PENDING`) and from the Invoice page action bar (already scoped to `PENDING`)
- On success, refreshes the bill list (bill-history) or navigates back to `home/billing` (Invoice page)
